ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominance of low-intensity black pixels (~60%) and mid-intensity mottled grey pixels (~35%), with localized high-intensity white highlights (~5%) concentrated along the central ridge and leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe is characterized by contiguous low-intensity dark pigmentation; the right lobe contains a large, irregular mid-intensity mottled geometric blob in the central region; a high-intensity linear vertical feature aligns with the central peduncle axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 82 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern consisting of sharp triangular peaks (pixel-amplitude 5-15px) and non-uniform valleys along the entire visible trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curve fitted to the outer edges, transitioning to a sharp inward concavity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters detected near the superior-lateral margins of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of distinct, low-intensity parallel linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the left lobe, oriented diagonally from the center toward the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel linear rake marks on the left lobe surface and irregular mechanical-type wear/serrations along the trailing edge margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-intensity (white) linear ridge feature at the 2D coordinate intersection of the fluke lobes and peduncle.
